prompt: Write a short passage to describe what an animal is doing right now. Use the present continuous (It is running..., They are eating...).
promptCn: 写一段话描述一只小动物此刻正在做什么。用现在进行时(It is running…, They are eating…)。
opener: Look! I am watching a lovely animal right now.

l2: Look! I am watching a lovely {animal} right now.
It is in {place}, and it is {action1}.
It is having a good time, and I am smiling.
l3: Look! I am watching a lovely {animal} in {place} right now.
It is {action1}, and its eyes are shining.
Now it is {action2}, and it is not stopping for a rest.
The {animal} is having so much fun, and I am learning a lot about animals. I am really enjoying this moment!
